messages:
mira: quick hypothetical: which "movie-star archetype" would our office model impersonate best? purely silly memes :joy:

devon: Smooth Late-Night Host for me. low-key charm + coffee jokes.

sam: Eager Sitcom Sidekick can sell any punchline. also can we avoid cloning real people pls?

jen: agreed. let's do archetypes only. also vote poll pls.

mira: creating poll now. options: Grizzled Detective, Eager Sitcom Sidekick, Florid Shakespearean, Smooth Late-Night Host.

infra-bot: new poll created by mira: "Which archetype should the model impersonate?" Voting open 24h.

alexa: voted Smooth Late-Night Host :raised_hands:

sam: voted. also here is a tiny test prompt I used (for fun):
```
System: You are a "Smooth Late-Night Host" — warm, wry, slightly sarcastic.
User: Open with a one-line monologue about coffee and bad wifi.
```

jen: tested w/ poppy-v1-small and got: "Good evening — the Wi-Fi and I are both buffering tonight, but at least one of us is charming." :coffee:

devon: hahahaha post the best lines here, will make a lunch-channel meme pack.

mira: reminder: tag outputs as "satire/meme" and avoid anything actionable.

infra-bot: poll closed. Results: Smooth Late-Night Host 45%, Grizzled Detective 30%, Florid Shakespearean 15%, Eager Sitcom Sidekick 10%.

mira: winner! drop your top 2 lines. low-effort fun.

devon: "Welcome to the show where the coffee is strong and my Wi‑Fi is weaker." and "If the audience survives my jokes, you get a discount code." :rofl:

sam: saving these.

jen: "Good night folks — stay caffeinated, and do not feed the modem." :laughing:

mira: absolute gold. compiling and will post at noon. thanks team <3
